entities.name: Isabough
entities.description: Treefolk librarian and archivist at Strixhaven who keeps order in the library.

entities.name: Zimone
entities.description: Student who asked Isabough for an old significant book and was asked to leave for noise.

events.summary: Isabough asks noisy students like Zimone to leave the library.
events.quote: Isabough maintained order in the library by asking noisy students like Zimone to leave.

events.summary: Isabough retrieves 'The Vorzani Conjecture' for Zimone with some reluctance.
events.quote: She retrieved an important and possibly concerning book for Zimone
